1. Review current posts in `src/lib/blog-data.ts` to confirm field usage, tone, and categories.
2. Draft the blog content and metadata using the checklist below; align with patterns in `references
3. Add a new `BlogPost` object to `BLOG_POSTS` and ensure any new image exists under `public/blog/`.
4. Sanity check: `slug` is unique, `date` is ISO `YYYY-MM-DD`, and `seo` fields are complete.
- `slug`: lowercase, hyphenated; prefer `YYYY-MM-DD-topic` for date-stamped posts.
- `excerpt`: 1-2 sentences; match the opening value of the post.
- `content`: Markdown in a template string; start with an H2 matching the title.
- `category`: use an existing category where possible; add new only when necessary.
- `author`: keep consistent with existing author unless instructed otherwise.

content.user_title: Create SEO Blog Posts for Next.js
content.value_statement: Blog teams often lose consistency when each post uses different fields, tone, and SEO details. This skill guides Claude, Codex, or Claude Code to draft posts that match the existing Next.js BlogPost pattern.
actual_capabilities: Guides review of existing BlogPost fields before adding new content.
Drafts Markdown blog content with short paragraphs and clear subheadings.
Produces slug, title, excerpt, date, read time, category, author, image, and SEO guidance.
Encourages reuse of current categories, author details, and site tone.
Supports source sections when factual claims need citations.
limitations: It is tailored to one Next.js BlogPost data structure.
It does not verify facts unless the user provides sources or asks for research.
It does not create image assets by itself.
It cannot guarantee SEO performance after publication.

use_cases.title: Publish a New Advisory Post
use_cases.description: Create a complete blog draft with metadata for a Jamaica-focused insurance or financial planning topic.

use_cases.title: Standardize Existing Blog Updates
use_cases.description: Revise a post so its fields, tone, structure, and SEO details match the current site pattern.

use_cases.title: Prepare Research-Based Content
use_cases.description: Draft a post that includes a clear source section when facts, data points, or regulations are cited.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Simple Post
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a new article draft.
prompt_templates.prompt: Write a new blog post about home insurance basics in Jamaica. Include a suggested title, excerpt, category, read time, and SEO details.

prompt_templates.title: Match Existing Site Structure
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request that needs structure alignment.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the existing BlogPost pattern, then draft a post about retirement planning for Jamaican professionals. Keep the tone and metadata consistent.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Source-Based Article
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a blog post about life insurance planning. Include a Sources section and mark any factual claims that need user-provided citations.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Publication Update
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a complete publication-ready blog entry for a new financial planning topic. Include slug, image path suggestion, SEO keywords, and final sanity checks.

output_examples.input: Write a post about why young professionals in Jamaica should consider life insurance.
output_examples.output: A structured article draft with a clear title, short introduction, practical sections, SEO description, keyword ideas, and a closing action.

output_examples.input: Update this blog idea so it matches our existing content style.
output_examples.output: A revised outline with matching tone, suggested category, stronger excerpt, cleaner headings, and metadata checks for publication.

output_examples.input: Create a post using research sources about emergency funds.
output_examples.output: A source-aware article draft with citation placeholders, a numbered Sources section, and notes for claims that need verification.

best_practices: Review current posts before changing categories, author details, or image conventions.
Provide sources for statistics, regulations, and market claims.
Keep the title, excerpt, and SEO description aligned with the article promise.
anti_patterns: Do not invent financial facts, rates, or regulations without sources.
Do not add a new category when an existing category fits.
Do not publish with missing slug, date, image, or SEO fields.

faq.question: What type of blog does this skill support?
faq.answer: It supports a Next.js blog that stores posts in a BlogPost data structure.

faq.question: Can it write full article content?
faq.answer: Yes. It can draft Markdown-style article content with headings, short paragraphs, and action steps.

faq.question: Does it handle SEO metadata?
faq.answer: Yes. It guides titles, descriptions, keywords, slugs, excerpts, and read time details.

faq.question: Is it limited to Jamaica-focused content?
faq.answer: The references target Jamaican households and professionals, but users can adapt the topic if needed.

faq.question: Does it create images?
faq.answer: No. It suggests image paths and reminds users to ensure assets exist.

faq.question: Can Claude Code or Codex use this skill?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
